# opnsense_haproxy_cpu (Data Source)

HAProxy CPU affinity rules (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Global Parameters ▸ CPU Affinity Rules**, plugin `os-haproxy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the CPU affinity rule.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_id` (Set of String) Bind the process/thread ID to this CPU. One of `all`, `odd`, `even`, `x0`, `x1`, `x2`, `x3`, `x4`, `x5`, `x6`, `x7`, `x8`, `x9`, `x10`, `x11`, `x12`, `x13`, `x14`, `x15`, `x16`, `x17`, `x18`, `x19`, `x20`, `x21`, `x22`, `x23`, `x24`, `x25`, `x26`, `x27`, `x28`, `x29`, `x30`, `x31`, `x32`, `x33`, `x34`, `x35`, `x36`, `x37`, `x38`, `x39`, `x40`, `x41`, `x42`, `x43`, `x44`, `x45`, `x46`, `x47`, `x48`, `x49`, `x50`, `x51`, `x52`, `x53`, `x54`, `x55`, `x56`, `x57`, `x58`, `x59`, `x60`, `x61`, `x62`, `x63`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this CPU affinity rule.
- `name` (String) Choose a name for this CPU affinity rule.
- `thread_id` (String) Thread ID that should bind to a specific CPU set. Any thread IDs above nbthread are ignored. One of `all`, `odd`, `even`, `x1`, `x2`, `x3`, `x4`, `x5`, `x6`, `x7`, `x8`, `x9`, `x10`, `x11`, `x12`, `x13`, `x14`, `x15`, `x16`, `x17`, `x18`, `x19`, `x20`, `x21`, `x22`, `x23`, `x24`, `x25`, `x26`, `x27`, `x28`, `x29`, `x30`, `x31`, `x32`, `x33`, `x34`, `x35`, `x36`, `x37`, `x38`, `x39`, `x40`, `x41`, `x42`, `x43`, `x44`, `x45`, `x46`, `x47`, `x48`, `x49`, `x50`, `x51`, `x52`, `x53`, `x54`, `x55`, `x56`, `x57`, `x58`, `x59`, `x60`, `x61`, `x62`, `x63`.
